policy.basis: Each reviewer must process the actual waveform and recover the line-specific critical phrase gates. Aggregate character error rate cannot override a critical mismatch. Signal, codec, clipping, loudness, and silence are assessed separately.
policy.limitation: Automated speech recognition does not constitute a human naturalness or accent audition.

excludedCapabilityChecks.reason: The service explicitly returned that it could not analyse the attached waveform.

criteria: character error rate at or below 0.15 after every critical gate passes
